body:
Already fixed on main — this is the same defect as #4154.

Fix: PR #4182 (commit a8dcc37db, merged 2026-07-30). `MessagingServicePlugin` now declares `SysNotification` (imported from `@objectstack/platform-objects/audit`) in its own manifest and provisions its table at `kernel:ready` via `provisionSystemTables`, instead of relying on the optional `AuditPlugin` to register it. A pin test (`plugin-declares-event-object.test.ts`) guards the invariant.

Why 17.0.0-rc.0 still shows the bug: the rc.0 tag was cut **before** a8dcc37db landed (`git merge-base --is-ancestor` confirms the fix is not an ancestor of `@objectstack/service-messaging@17.0.0-rc.0`). The mechanism matches exactly what this issue observed: with `sys_notification` unregistered, `findEventByDedupKey` tolerates the failed lookup and `writeEvent` falls into the synthesize-an-id path, so `dedupKey` never short-circuits.

The fix ships with the next 17.0.0 rc/stable release. Closing as fixed-pending-release; see #4154 for the root-cause discussion.
